_note: Kimi-K3 open-ended optimizer case, CHUNKED PREFILL variant: ONE KDA decoder layer on sglang v0.5.20, B200, cookbook production shape (12 KDA heads/rank, bf16 recurrent state, EP8 rank = 112 mxfp4 routed experts, local top-2 share). Points are prefill chunks (ForwardMode.EXTEND): B requests x L NEW tokens each on a <prefix>-token context; the K3 B200 default chunked_prefill_size is 16384. Metric = eager step time (sglang does not graph-capture prefill). Correctness = output + post-chunk conv/recurrent state vs a seeded golden from the pristine tree. Driver runs with --bf16-gemm-init (production scheduler's bf16 GEMM backend init: auto -> cutedsl TGV/split-K dispatch on SM100); the original decode cases keep the legacy cuBLAS-only dispatch (measured effect <= 0.7%). Also --flashinfer-autotune (production's FlashInfer autotune warmup; without it the MXFP4 MoE runs a fallback tactic).

render.METRIC: eager chunked-prefill step latency of one Kimi-K3 KDA decoder layer
render.MODEL_NAME: Kimi-K3 (moonshotai/Kimi-K3): one KDA (linear-attention) decoder layer, as it runs on one B200 of the production TP8/EP8 deployment (12 attention heads, 112 local mxfp4 experts, bf16 recurrent state)
render.WORKLOAD: chunked prefill (ForwardMode.EXTEND), one chunk per step: 1 request x 16,384 new tokens as the FIRST chunk of a prompt (primary; the B200 default chunked_prefill_size; the routed MXFP4 MoE sees ~32k local rows and is GEMM-bound, KDA runs the chunked scan chunk_kda), plus the same 16k chunk as the 4th chunk of a 64k prompt (prefix 49,152 tokens: conv + recurrent state carried in) and a mixed batch of 4 requests x 4,096 first-chunk tokens (must not regress)
render.REBUILD_CMD: find /sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; cd /tmp && python3 /tmp/kimi_single_layer_decode.py --point 1,2048,pf --attn-type kda --moe-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --attn-heads 12 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --experts 112 --ep 8 --local-topk 2 --hidden-scale 1.0 --cuda-graph --iters 5 --warmup 2 --bf16-gemm-init --flashinfer-autotune && echo LAYER_SMOKE_OK
